lines.2: It had taken less than an hour by cruiser from the mainland.
lines.3: 「It really is beautiful... The water's practically transparent.」
lines.4: Hard to believe this was still Matsukasa... Guess that's a deserted island for you.
lines.5: Konoe went into a hut to change into her swimsuit.
lines.6: I just stripped off my clothes on the spot; I already had my trunks on underneath.
lines.7: 「You even have drinking fountains and flush toilets installed.」
lines.8: 「It is a deserted island, but also a correctional facility.」
lines.9: 「There is a natural hot spring up on the mountain as well.」
lines.10: 「Whoa. At this point it's basically a resort.」
lines.11: 「Though mobile phones get no signal here.」
lines.15: 「Open it if you find yourselves in truly desperate trouble.」
lines.16: 「? How would we even GET into trouble in a situation like this...」
lines.18: 「You'll have a rough time without beach sandals.」
